answer: To form a secure haven against Sybil swarms, agents anchor identities in cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. A progressive staking curve imposes an exponential capital exhaustion cost on each duplicate agent: while an initial node requires a modest stake, mass replication scales exponentially, driving attacker expenditure to an insurmountable zenith. Even elite ivory tower cartels face superlinear costs that render large-scale identity spoofing mathematically unviable.
